name: smwgraphics-alternate-redrawn-styled-dino-rhino-dino-torch
title: Alternate Redrawn Styled Dino Rhino & Dino Torch
description:
Alternative Redrawn-styled graphics for SMW Dino Rhino and Dino Torch, meant to closely resemble their official artwork and their latest modern appearances in Paper Mario: Color Splash and Paper Mario: The Origami King, all while having them walk like in vanilla Super Mario World.

Credit's not necessary, but heavily appreciated regardless.
